State-space dynamics provide temporal coherence through nested AR(1) and Gaussian processes, enabling adaptive team strength modeling. Market microstructure integrates external signals like CLV into predictive frameworks. These components interlock mathematically: CQR provides calibrated outputs for state-space models, while CLV acts as an informative prior. Dualities emerge in how uncertainty propagation mirrors belief updating under stochastic dynamics. Failure modes include overfitting in calibration when sample size is small, non-stationarity in state-space models, and misalignment between market sentiment and true outcome probabilities.
